Testicular function. Chorionic gonadotrophin is used in the assessment of testicular function in suspected primary hypogo- nadism and incomplete masculinisation. The BNFC states that for children 1 month to 18 years of age a dose of 1500 to 2000 units may be given once daily for 3 days (short stimulation test) or twice weekly for 3 weeks (prolonged test).
